services.name: Adult Tours
services.desc: We offer students and teachers the opportunity to immerse themselves in our exhibitions through inquiry-based learning and hands-on activities. With nearly 100 member schools and service organizations, the KMA Education Department is a rich resource for curriculum-based learning. We encourage collaboration to develop new ways of connecting visual observation to classroom objectives. Each new exhibition, part of a diverse schedule that explores ideas about art, culture, and society, affords a unique opportunity for the study of fine art, language arts, social studies, and the sciences.
